stations.title: Dorrit
stations.say: Can it write ticket 2187 for me?

stations.title: Paper slip
stations.text: Written out by hand, wrong when it's busy.

captions: Dorrit at the counter wants the laptop to write ticket 2187 for Edwina Sallow's clock.
Today it is written by hand, and the laptop once promised it in thirty thousand days.
You put the slip into variables with types and print the ticket, in four tasks.
Now the ticket line, the bench and shelf, the quote and the days all come out right.
Every box of the slip is a variable now, and the laptop writes the ticket.
